title: Hospitals and universities repurposing drugs at 90% lower cost
summary: King's College London reports on how hospitals and universities are repurposing existing drugs at approximately 90% lower cost than traditional drug development, potentially revolutionizing access to treatments for various conditions.
problem_solved: Addresses the prohibitive cost and lengthy timeline of traditional drug development that limits patient access to affordable treatments.
why_valuable: Drug repurposing can cut development costs by 90% while accelerating time-to-market for new therapeutic applications, potentially saving lives and reducing healthcare expenses.
